verdict.rationale: Docs show balance accounts holding per-card or pooled funds, webhooks for payment/transfer events (funds added/deducted) and a generic Report webhook, plus Customer Area views of card payments — giving some real-time visibility into balances and transactions. However there is no explicit documentation of a unified transaction ledger tying each authorization to its clearing/settlement, nor of penny-accurate settlement reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: dedicated ledger/settlement reconciliation reports, explicit authorization-to-clearing matching documentation, and any reconciliation accuracy guarantees or third-party validation.
